Requirement_Text: Energy harvest loss shall not affect aircraft safety functions
CO2 concentration in equipment bay shall not exceed 30000 ppm continuous
Rationale: Prevent crew hazard during maintenance access

Requirement_Text: CO2 sensors shall be installed with 1oo2 voting per bay
Bay ventilation rate shall be >= 6 ACH
CO2 detection response time shall be <= 30 s
Pressure relief shall activate at 1.5x MAWP
Cabin CO2 concentration shall not exceed 5000 ppm
CO2 system isolation valve shall close in <= 5 s on detection
Battery thermal isolation shall prevent cell-to-cell propagation
Rationale: Contain thermal runaway to single cell

Requirement_Text: Cooling system failure shall be detected within 5 s
Fire suppression shall activate within 1 s of fire detection
Battery pack shall contain fire for minimum 10 min
No propagation to adjacent cells within 5 min of single cell runaway
Off-gas detection shall trigger alert within 10 s
Water quality monitoring shall be continuous during operation
Automatic bypass shall activate on quality limit exceedance
Filtration shall achieve 4-log reduction of pathogens
UV sterilization shall provide minimum 40 mJ/cm2 dose
Loss of water recycling shall not affect essential water supply
ANCHORS installation shall not reduce structural margins below 1.5
Inspection access shall be provided for all attachment points
Thermal barrier shall limit structure temperature to <= 85°C
Temperature sensors shall monitor structure adjacent to battery bays
Battery derating shall activate at coolant temperature > 40°C
Coolant leak detection shall trigger isolation within 10 s
Battery bay shall contain minimum 5 L coolant leak
Coolant shall be non-conductive dielectric fluid
H2 interface shall have dual containment
H2 leak detection shall trigger isolation within 5 s
H2 bay ventilation shall maintain concentration < 25% LEL
Ignition sources shall be isolated from H2 zones
ANCHORS status data shall be validated before display
AI/NN functions shall meet DAL C or better
CO2 cartridge shall have pressure relief at 1.5x MAWP
CO2 cartridge bay shall contain pressure release
Loss of all ANCHORS shall generate crew alert
